referenceFidelity.findings: Exact shared 18m radius foundation, 1.20m top, six edge anchors plus surface anchor. Two restrained flush concrete service pads and covered cable channels leave the parent-owned route unpainted. Slate #354B64 is unchanged throughout the outer 1.4m band.

construction.findings: Inspected iso, top and close-paving-edge views: continuous slab and trim, no raised pads, overlapping layers or cracks. Source uses the same 108-triangle foundation geometry and .92 roughness. Atlas changes return smoothly to the quiet slate band before the boundary.

readability.findings: Phone evidence keeps two large service zones readable while broad low-contrast concrete joints recede. Central service route remains free for the registered existing walkway models.

motion.findings: Static asset; no motion clips in the contract.

secondPass.findings: Rechecked close edge transition, reverse oblique and phone capture after the first iso/top assessment. Pad corners stay inside the common boundary and no surface height or frame correction was needed.

userAcceptance.note: Author self-review complete; explicit user artistic acceptance remains separate.

limitations: Static environment assembly; final whole-campus placement and composition are reviewed by the integrating parent task.
